title: Ways to Give
markdown:
# Ways to Give

Support The Center for Wooden Boats, a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit museum in Seattle, WA. Admission is always free.

## Make a Donation

[Donate](https://centerforwoodenboats2.my.site.com/gs/s/donate)

To donate boats, motors, trailers, woodworking tools and supplies, or maritime items, contact Steve at [sgreaves@cwb.org](mailto:sgreaves@cwb.org).

## Donate Stock

Contact [development@cwb.org](mailto:development@cwb.org?subject=DONATION). CWB Tax ID: 91-1061721. Stock gifts are credited on the day CWB receives them; our acknowledgement lists the number of shares but no dollar amount. Please consult a tax advisor about deductions for stock and non-cash gifts.

## Workplace Giving & Matching Gifts

Payroll giving is available through Benevity, YourCause, the Washington State Combined Fund Drive, and the King County Employee Giving Program. Charity codes: 9977 (King County) and 0456442 (Washington State).

[Click here for a sample list of companies known to match donations](https://www.cwb.org/s/Companies-with-Matching-Gift-Programs.pdf)

## Donate a Car

Visit [www.careasy.com](https://careasy.org/nonprofit/The-Center-for-Wooden-Boats) and search for "The Center for Wooden Boats."

## Memorial & Honorary Gifts

[Donate](https://centerforwoodenboats2.my.site.com/gs/s/donate) online and note "In memory" or "In honor" in the comment box.

## Navigator Club (Legacy Gifts)

Call 206-382-2628 or email [development@cwb.org](mailto:development@cwb.org).

## Donor Bill of Rights

CWB follows the Donor Bill of Rights. [You can view those rights here](https://www.cwb.org/s/AFP-Donor-Bill-of-Right.pdf).
